items.source: Note: hashCode equality between two keys key1 and key2 is only guaranteed if key1.equals(key2) and the keys were produced by the same factory.
items.translation: 注意：hashCode 在两个键 key1 和 key2 之间的相等性仅保证在key1.equals(key2)且这些键由同一工厂生成时成立。

items.source: Once you have made a KeyFactory, you generate a new key by calling the newInstance method defined by your interface.
items.translation: 一旦创建了 `KeyFactory`，您通过调用接口定义的 `newInstance` 方法生成新密钥。

items.source: Type.hashCode() is very expensive as it traverses full descriptor to calculate hash code. This customizer uses Type.getSort() as a hash code.
items.translation: Type.hashCode() 非常昂贵，因为它会遍历完整的描述符来计算哈希码。此自定义器使用 Type.getSort() 作为哈希码。

items.source: Type.hashCode() is very expensive as it traverses full descriptor to calculate hash code.
items.translation: Type.hashCode() 非常昂贵，因为它遍历完整的描述符来计算哈希码。

items.source: this customizer might result in unexpected class leak since key object still holds a strong reference to the Object and class.
items.translation: 此自定义器可能会导致意外的类泄漏，因为键对象仍然持有对对象和类的强引用。

items.source:
this customizer might result in unexpected class leak since key object still holds a strong reference to the Object and class.
It is recommended to have pre-processing method that would strip Objects and represent Classes as Strings
items.translation: 此自定义器可能会导致意外的类泄漏，因为键对象仍然持有对对象和类的强引用。建议实现一个预处理方法，将对象剥离并将类表示为字符串。
